call_points.text: Revenue growth guidance maintained; confident of top-quartile growth
ACV target for FY27: at least $170 million (last year's level)
Net operating cash flow at ₹107 Cr; OCF to EBITDA ratio at 38%
BFSI segment growth remains a concern; expects turnaround from H2FY27
FY27 guided to top-quartile revenue growth versus peers, with no numeric band given.
EBITDA margin band retained at 24-28% for FY27, same as FY26.
Q1FY27 expected to grow sequentially over Q4FY26.
First large-scale Agentic AI win booked in Q4, with revenue ramp expected from Q4FY27.
Analytics and automation is now a USD 90 million book and should grow faster than the company.
Q1 wage hike impact seen at 300-350 bps, similar to FY26.
FY26 operating cash flow ₹872.9 Cr and free cash flow ₹756 Cr, up 33% and 41%.
Buybacks will remain the preferred capital-return route over dividends.
Proposed US NPRM on offshore call-centre restrictions could hurt the CMT vertical if enacted.
Management conceded AI and competition may cause some deflationary pressure on bookings.
